purpose: Six topic rotating, nonpublishing Bouriko video quality tests

topics.topic: Jujutsu Kaisen Culling Game rules explained
topics.requirements: Canon sourced and visually meaningful character/map/rule examples; unlicensed anime frames cannot be represented as cleared for publishing.

topics.topic: How GPS finds you and navigation apps estimate ETA
topics.requirements: Explain satellites versus ETA model, map route and traffic evidence.

topics.topic: How traffic lights detect a waiting car using inductive loops cameras radar and timers
topics.requirements: Use accurate loop diagram and appropriate traffic light footage, verify mechanisms.

topics.topic: How beauty products are formulated and tested for safety
topics.requirements: Treat beauty as a science explainer; verified cosmetic science references and relevant product/method footage.

topics.topic: Most recent verified iPhone news and features
topics.requirements: Confirm newest announcement date and facts using Apple primary sources, use authentic rights-cleared footage of the relevant iPhone model; fail instead of unrelated generic phone B-roll.

topics.topic: How a faceless YouTube Shorts channel like Night Files creates its videos
topics.requirements: Ground the explanation in the actual Venloud/horror-shorts workflow: topic research, narration, clips, diagrams, rendering, QA and disabled Bouriko social posting. Do not show credentials, secrets or incorrectly claim public uploads.
